提交整批任务；关闭网页不会取消已提交任务。: Submit all rounds. Closing the page does not cancel submitted tasks.

超限时从最早图片处理：未喜欢的永久删除本地图片及提示词 JSON；喜欢的仅从漫游: When exceeded, remove the oldest images: delete unliked files and prompt JSON permanently; hide liked images from Roam while keeping them in Liked.
仅计算当前图片之前的漫游历史；当前、预取与生成页图片不计。0 关闭数量清理。: Only roam images before the current image count. Current, prefetched, and manually generated images are excluded. Set 0 to disable.
每张图片加载完成后开始计时；下一张未就绪时等待。: Time starts after the image loads. Wait if the next image is not ready.
标准模式每次准备的完整组合数；强力模式按倍数增加。候选越多通常等待越久。: Complete combinations prepared per request in Standard mode. Strong mode multiplies this count. More candidates usually take longer.
强力模式的候选组合数量 = 候选组合数量 × 倍数。只影响新任务。: Strong mode candidate count = candidate count × multiplier. Applies to new tasks only.
从图片入库起计时，默认 1 天；0 关闭过期清理，喜欢的图片保留。: Time since an image was saved. Defaults to 1 day. Set 0 to disable expiry cleanup. Liked images are kept.
到期且未喜欢的本地图片及提示词 JSON 将永久删除。: Expired unliked local images and prompt JSON will be permanently deleted.
取消喜欢后，已过期图片也会被清理。任务记录和 ComfyUI 文件保留。: Removing a like makes expired images eligible for cleanup. Task history and ComfyUI files are kept.
保存后立即检查；之后在启动、浏览或生成等操作时按需清理。: Check immediately after saving, then on startup, browsing, or generating.
